decisions.reason: Customer-database isolation is a separate behavior already introduced from message 55; the analytics-specific modification does not change it.
Gift-card isolation is a separate behavior already introduced from message 55 and is unchanged by the analytics-specific modification.
Membership isolation is independently stated and already represented; separating Ridgehaven analytics does not alter membership management.
The source analytics decision does not modify the existing rule that each location maintains a separate calendar.
Message 55 already has a target-specific booking MODIFY covering Ridgehaven isolation and activation; the analytics modification adds no booking change.
Ridgehaven analytics isolation does not change Harbor Valley legacy-site availability or its master-site linkage.
Staff-access isolation is a separate behavior already introduced from message 55 and is unaffected by the analytics-specific modification.
The existing payout state already requires separate location payouts and payment setups; the analytics decision neither changes nor removes those rules.
The analytics separation decision has no necessary effect on SEO preservation during the rebrand and migration.
The candidate already requires each location, including Ridgehaven, to use its own payment processing and setup; analytics isolation does not change that state.
The separate template clause in message 55 is already represented by a same-message MODIFY; the analytics-specific change adds no further expansion or template update.
Separating Ridgehaven analytics does not change the source materials, reused content, or purpose of the legacy-content migration.
